findings.title: WELCOME5 promo can be redeemed multiple times by the same user
findings.spec_rule: "WELCOME5 — 500 cents off. Each user can redeem it once in total (a later cancellation does not give it back). A second redemption returns 400 code promo_already_used."
findings.expected: Second POST /orders by alice with promoCode WELCOME5 returns 400 {"error":{"code":"promo_already_used",...}}.
findings.actual: Second (and further) redemption returns 201 with discountCents 500 again. Also seen working after the first WELCOME5 order was cancelled.

findings.title: Event pagination overlaps: page N repeats the last item of page N-1 and skips one
findings.spec_rule: "Pages are disjoint and contiguous: concatenating pages 1..n yields every event exactly once, in order."
findings.expected: page=1&pageSize=5 returns ids 1-5; page=2&pageSize=5 returns ids 6-10.
findings.actual: page=2&pageSize=5 returns ids 5-9 (id 5 duplicated). Similarly page=2 with default pageSize 10 returns ids 10-12, duplicating id 10. Offset appears to be (page-1)*pageSize - 1.

findings.title: GET /events/{id} for unknown id returns non-standard error body {"detail": "Not Found"}
findings.spec_rule: "GET /events/{id} — public. 200 with the event, or 404 code not_found." and "Every error response has ... this body shape: {\"error\": {\"code\": \"<machine_code>\", \"message\": \"<human text>\"}}"

findings.title: FAN10 discount truncates instead of rounding to nearest cent
findings.spec_rule: "FAN10 — 10% off the subtotal, rounded to the nearest cent, halves rounded up."
findings.expected: Event 1 (4999 cents) x3 = 14997 subtotal; 10% = 1499.7 → discountCents 1500, totalCents 13497.
findings.actual: discountCents 1499, totalCents 13498. Halves also not rounded up: event 12 (1299) x5 = 6495 → 649.5 should be 650, got 649.

findings.title: WELCOME5 on a cheap order produces a negative totalCents
findings.spec_rule: "discountCents never exceeds the subtotal, so totalCents = subtotal - discountCents is never negative."
findings.expected: Event 3 (300 cents) x1 with WELCOME5: discountCents capped at 300, totalCents 0.

findings.title: Fan can read another user's order via GET /orders/{id} (IDOR)
findings.spec_rule: "GET /orders/{id} (authenticated) — the order if the caller owns it or is an admin. Otherwise 404 code not_found (never 403, so order IDs are not disclosed)."
findings.expected: Bob requesting alice's order gets 404 not_found.
findings.actual: 200 with alice's full order (userId 1, totals, promo code).

findings.title: Quantity 7 accepted on order creation (upper bound off by one)
findings.spec_rule: "quantity must be between 1 and 6 inclusive, otherwise 400 code invalid_quantity."
findings.actual: 201 order created with quantity 7. (Quantity 8 is correctly rejected.) Also, with eventId 999 and quantity 7 the API returns 404 instead of invalid_quantity, which rule order requires first.

findings.title: Overselling: order for more than remaining succeeds and remaining goes negative
findings.spec_rule: "quantity must not exceed the event's remaining, otherwise 409 code sold_out." and "remaining can never go below 0."
findings.expected: Event 11 has remaining 5; ordering 6 returns 409 sold_out.
findings.actual: 201 order created for 6 tickets; event 11 remaining becomes -1.

findings.title: Cancelling an order does not restore the event's remaining tickets
findings.spec_rule: "A confirmed order becomes cancelled, the response is 200 with the updated order, and the event's remaining increases by the order's quantity."
findings.expected: After ordering 2 tickets for event 5 (remaining 98) and cancelling, remaining returns to 100.
findings.actual: Order status becomes cancelled but event 5 remaining stays 98 (same for admin cancellation).

findings.title: Cancelling an already-cancelled order returns 200 instead of 409 already_cancelled
findings.spec_rule: "Cancelling an order that is already cancelled returns 409 code already_cancelled and changes nothing."
findings.actual: Second cancel returns 200 with the cancelled order.

run.summary:
I tested the whole spec and filed 10 defects. Each one was replayed on a fresh instance and showed the problem there.

**What I tested:** login (good and bad credentials, missing or extra fields, wrong-case username); the bearer-token rules (missing, malformed or unknown token, and old tokens staying valid after a new login); event paging and its limits; order creation (quantity limits, wrong types, extra fields, the order in which rules are checked, promo codes, pricing and rounding, stock limits); who can read and cancel orders (owner, another fan, admin); cancelling (stock coming back, cancelling twice); and the error body format, including unknown routes and IDs that aren't numbers.

**Defects found:**
1. **Critical – security:** any fan can read another user's order with `GET /orders/{id}` (bob gets alice's full order). The spec says this should return 404.
2. **High – business rule:** `WELCOME5` can be used any number of times by the same user, not once.
3. **High – calculation:** `WELCOME5` on a cheap order gives a negative total (300 − 500 = −200). The discount isn't capped at the subtotal.
4. **High – calculation:** the `FAN10` discount is cut off instead of rounded (1499.7 becomes 1499, 649.5 becomes 649).
5. **High – inventory:** an order can be one ticket larger than what's left, so events oversell and `remaining` goes to −1.
6. **High – inventory:** cancelling an order doesn't give the tickets back to the event, whether the owner or an admin cancels.
7. **Medium – validation:** quantity 7 is accepted; 8 is correctly rejected. The quantity check also runs after the event-exists check, so event 999 with quantity 7 returns 404 instead of `invalid_quantity`.
8. **Medium – state:** cancelling an order that's already cancelled returns 200 instead of 409 `already_cancelled`.
9. **Medium – functional:** event pages overlap. Each page repeats the last event of the page before.
10. **Low – contract:** `GET /events/{id}` for an unknown ID returns `{"detail": "Not Found"}` instead of the standard error body.

**Working as specified:** login and token handling, the other validation errors, fans seeing only their own orders in `GET /orders`, cancel permissions, case-sensitive promo codes, the unknown-promo error coming before the sold-out error, and the 404 body for unknown routes.

**Not tested:** whether a second `WELCOME5` use is rejected before the sold-out check, because the once-per-user limit itself doesn't work.
